lead.title: Amazon Ads turns its ad platform into an agentic media-buying system
lead.deck: Amazon Ads Agent unifies sponsored ads, full-funnel campaigns and programmatic display/video/audio around conversational AI, while adding MCP connectivity and natural-language planning, optimization and analytics.

note: Manually published from the latest saved research after automated generation ran out of API credits. Coverage includes developments announced through 30 September; some background items are older than the preferred 24–48-hour window and are retained for context.

stories.title: OpenAI launches always-on Dots for ongoing work
stories.summary: WHAT: OpenAI introduced Dots, persistent agents with a cloud computer, connected apps and recurring work. WHY: Marketing teams can move from one-off prompts to agents that continuously monitor and execute workflows. USE: Give a Dot responsibility for a daily competitor/news scan, campaign QA queue or reporting checklist, with human approval for consequential actions. TOOL: ChatGPT Dots. STATUS: Confirmed product launch.

stories.title: Meta expands Muse into connected small-business workflows
stories.summary: WHAT: Muse for Small Business connects tools including Shopify, Klaviyo, Canva, Slack and business accounts, while requiring approval before publishing, sending or spending. WHY: An agent can work across marketing, commerce and operations instead of living inside one app. USE: Connect ecommerce, CRM and creative tools to research customers, prepare campaigns and surface follow-ups for approval. TOOL: Meta Muse. STATUS: Confirmed product update.

stories.title: Meta packages Muse, Business Agent and Muse API for enterprises
stories.summary: WHAT: Meta launched Meta Enterprise Platform around Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API and Muse Code. WHY: Agencies and brands can increasingly treat Meta's AI capabilities as building blocks for business workflows. USE: Explore agent-assisted campaign operations, customer support and internal marketing automation where APIs and permissions permit. TOOL: Meta Enterprise Platform. STATUS: Confirmed announcement.

stories.title: Google's AI Max reporting connects search terms, assets and landing pages
stories.summary: WHAT: Google is expanding AI Max reporting to provide more visibility across the search term, creative asset and landing-page journey. WHY: Automation is harder to audit when query-to-ad-to-LP relationships are opaque. USE: Use the journey view during weekly QA to identify mismatched intent, weak assets and landing pages that need refinement. TOOL: Google Ads AI Max. STATUS: Confirmed product update.

stories.title: Google continues building ads for AI Mode and conversational Search
stories.summary: WHAT: Google is testing Gemini-powered ad formats in AI Mode, including conversational discovery and AI-assisted product guidance. WHY: Search advertising is moving beyond a keyword-and-SERP interaction toward richer decision support. USE: Prepare structured product/service information, strong landing pages and assets that can support conversational evaluation. TOOL: Google Search AI Mode and Google Ads. STATUS: Confirmed testing; availability varies.

stories.title: Meta's AI stack is moving closer to campaign operations
stories.summary: WHAT: Muse can connect to Facebook and Instagram business accounts alongside commerce, CRM and creative tools. WHY: The same agent can potentially understand business context across creative, customer and ad workflows. USE: Test an approval-based workflow that turns business goals into campaign research, creative drafts and operational checklists rather than allowing autonomous publishing. TOOL: Meta Muse + Meta business accounts. STATUS: Confirmed rollout.

stories.title: Microsoft Advertising brings campaign revenue data into HubSpot
stories.summary: WHAT: Microsoft Advertising is now available in HubSpot so CRM data can be used to reach high-value audiences and connect campaigns with pipeline and revenue. WHY: Lead-gen optimization can move beyond form fills toward downstream business outcomes. USE: Map qualified-lead and revenue stages into reporting before changing bidding or budget decisions. TOOL: Microsoft Advertising + HubSpot. STATUS: Confirmed product update.

stories.title: Microsoft raises LinkedIn company-list limits to 10,000 accounts
stories.summary: WHAT: Advertisers can now add up to 10,000 company names per LinkedIn company list, up from 1,000, for supported Search and Audience campaigns. WHY: B2B teams can operationalize much larger account-based marketing lists. USE: Build segmented target-account lists by industry, tier or sales stage and test them against broader prospecting. TOOL: Microsoft Advertising + LinkedIn profile targeting. STATUS: Confirmed product update.

stories.title: Microsoft makes optimization experiments generally available
stories.summary: WHAT: Controlled experiments are now generally available for Search, Shopping, Audience and Performance Max campaigns. WHY: Automated bidding and targeting need structured testing rather than assumption-based rollouts. USE: Test one material change at a time, compare against the original campaign, then apply a validated winner. TOOL: Microsoft Advertising Optimization Experiments. STATUS: Confirmed availability.

stories.title: Microsoft extends the SOAP-to-REST API migration deadline
stories.summary: WHAT: Microsoft will keep new features available in both SOAP and REST until SOAP is deprecated on 31 Jan 2027. WHY: Agencies with custom reporting, automation or bid-management integrations have more migration time but should not delay indefinitely. USE: Inventory SOAP dependencies, migrate critical jobs to REST, and regression-test reporting before the final deadline. TOOL: Microsoft Advertising REST API. STATUS: Confirmed API policy change.

stories.title: TikTok One Content Suite API turns creator content into Spark Ads
stories.summary: WHAT: TikTok says ShopMy Spotlights can use the TikTok One Content Suite API to turn high-performing affiliate creator content into Spark Ads. WHY: Creator-content discovery and paid amplification are becoming more programmatic. USE: Identify proven creator assets, obtain permissions, then scale the strongest content into paid campaigns instead of producing every ad from scratch. TOOL: TikTok One Content Suite API + Spark Ads. STATUS: Confirmed partner/API announcement.

stories.title: Google Search Central holds a Deep Dive Europe session on AI-era Search
stories.summary: WHAT: Google Search Central's Deep Dive Europe took place on 30 Sep, with Search-focused sessions from Google's team. WHY: First-party guidance remains important as AI Search, structured data and SERP behavior evolve. USE: Treat Google documentation and Search Central guidance as the source of truth before changing technical SEO or AEO workflows based on third-party speculation. TOOL: Google Search Central. STATUS: Confirmed event; specific session takeaways should be verified against published guidance.

stories.title: Google's September spam update remains a live SEO monitoring item
stories.summary: WHAT: Google's September 2026 spam update began rolling out on 24 Sep. WHY: Ranking volatility during a core search-system change can be mistaken for site-specific technical problems. USE: Segment organic traffic by query type, landing page and country, and wait for the rollout to complete before making major reactive SEO changes. TOOL: Google Search Console. STATUS: Confirmed Google update; industry reporting is monitoring impact.

stories.title: OpenAI Ads API adds selectable attribution windows and time basis
stories.summary: WHAT: OpenAI's Advertiser API changelog says all four Insights endpoints now support selectable click/view attribution windows and time basis; omitted settings default to 30-day click, 1-day view and ad-event time. WHY: API-based reporting can change when conversion totals are defined differently. USE: Lock attribution settings explicitly in dashboards and compare historical reports carefully before calling a trend a performance change. TOOL: OpenAI Ads Advertiser API. STATUS: Confirmed API update.

stories.title: Amazon Ads adds AI-assisted creative production to Full-Funnel Campaigns
stories.summary: WHAT: Amazon's Full-Funnel Campaigns can generate additional images and TV-ready video assets when needed, with advertiser approval before launch. WHY: Media planning and creative production are converging inside the buying workflow. USE: Test AI-generated variants for prospecting while keeping brand review and final approval human-controlled. TOOL: Amazon Ads Agent / Full-Funnel Campaigns. STATUS: Confirmed open beta in the US.

stories.title: Amazon Ads launches an MCP Server Lite for agent workflows
stories.summary: WHAT: Amazon Ads announced an MCP Server (Lite) that helps agents discover and invoke advertising capabilities without loading the full toolset upfront. WHY: MCP can become a standard bridge between marketing data and AI agents. USE: Explore a read-only campaign-analysis agent first, then add tightly scoped actions with approval gates. TOOL: Amazon Ads MCP Server (Lite). STATUS: Confirmed announcement.

stories.title: Microsoft Advertising's REST migration becomes a key automation deadline
stories.summary: WHAT: Microsoft extended the SOAP deprecation deadline to 31 Jan 2027 while keeping new features in both APIs temporarily. WHY: Reporting, automation and internal tooling that still depend on SOAP need a migration plan. USE: Create a dependency inventory now and test REST equivalents in parallel rather than waiting for the cutoff. TOOL: Microsoft Advertising API / SDK. STATUS: Confirmed policy update.

stories.title: Amazon opens Full-Funnel Campaigns in the US
stories.summary: WHAT: Full-Funnel Campaigns is in open beta for US Amazon sellers, using one budget and an AI optimization engine across sponsored ads, display, video and streaming TV. WHY: Retail media is moving toward cross-format orchestration rather than isolated campaign management. USE: Test it as an incremental prospecting layer with a defined ROAS or sales-growth guardrail while preserving existing campaigns. TOOL: Amazon Ads Agent / Full-Funnel Campaigns. STATUS: Confirmed open beta.

stories.title: Amazon introduces Branded Conversations for AI shopping
stories.summary: WHAT: Branded Conversations lets brands provide expertise that Alexa for Shopping can use in product conversations, extending Sponsored Brands prompts into deeper AI-assisted shopping dialogue. WHY: Product discovery can increasingly happen inside an AI conversation rather than a traditional results page. USE: Prepare structured product expertise, differentiators and complementary-product guidance that an AI shopping assistant can use accurately. TOOL: Amazon Ads / Alexa for Shopping. STATUS: Confirmed announcement.

stories.title: Amazon launches Sponsored Services for local service providers
stories.summary: WHAT: Sponsored Services uses AI intent detection to connect Amazon customers with local and online service providers and supports outcomes such as quote requests, calls and ordering. WHY: Retail-media intent signals are expanding into service lead generation. USE: Local businesses can evaluate Amazon as an additional demand-capture channel when their services align with relevant product or shopping moments. TOOL: Amazon Ads Sponsored Services. STATUS: Confirmed launch announcement.

author: Yogesh Raghupati
